bradb0wman: Dorian Wman, a dance-hall violinist from Halden, was sent forward on Day 3 to fill a gap in R-F5. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it. The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Dorian Wman helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
caydan__: Dietrich Caydan signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F12 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Dietrich Caydan was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.

Dietrich Caydan was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Dietrich Caydan wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
dilloncoll2015: In Ashford Vale, Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll was a railway porter. In R-F17, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a railway porter again.

Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork. Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
jozifanderson: Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
First Wave. Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a bullet that missed him.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at the Chalk Pits, Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso was promoted to Lance Corporal.
The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
thebaileeblanks: Florian "Button" Thebaileebla left an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive behind in Marrow Fen and came up the line with a letter he never sent. The men noticed at once that he laughs at exactly the wrong moments. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Florian "Button" Thebaileebla watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
